mapper.select: SELECT sc.id, sc.type_name, sc.description, sc.price_multiplier, sc.create_time, sc.update_time, sc.create_user, sc.update_user, ca.name AS createUserName, ua.name AS updateUserName FROM service_category sc LEFT JOIN admin ca ON sc.create_user = ca.id LEFT JOIN admin ua ON sc.update_user = ua.id WHERE sc.id = #{id}
